name: Why should I use a general contractor instead of a standalone tub dealer?

mainEntity.name: Why should I use a general contractor instead of a standalone tub dealer?

acceptedAnswer.text: A general contractor manages the entire project scope under one roof, preventing scheduling delays and finger-pointing between separate trades. Independent tub installers often drop a unit into place but leave you to hire separate electricians, plumbers, drywall patchers, and tile installers to finish the room. Working with HH Remodeling gives you a single point of contact. Owner Abraham Becerra coordinates trade partners for rough plumbing and electrical while his dedicated finish crew repairs walls, installs custom tile surrounds, and finishes trim work cleanly.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general contractor coordinates all electrical, plumbing, wall framing, drywall, and finish tile work, giving you one accountable contact from start to finish.
